envelope.reason: the plan must not choose the sign that replaces delivery; it is owed to signify

payload.title: the architect objective's sign
payload.body: The architect position's gloss says its objective is the design realized, not a green pipeline, yet the architect role (roles/architect.ts) projects `objective: delivery ⟨end-to-end integrated green⟩` into architect, kino and mav (nico overrides it with parsimony); every cold read of the assay of 20961057 takes it as answering for integration and a green main. Which objective value replaces it is owed to signify: a new sign for 'the design realized', an existing catalog value (insight, correctness, thoroughness, parsimony …), or none (the role states no objective). Unit architect-role waits on the ruling and is revised to declare the chosen value's file.
